elements.element: The transition-assistance obligation must be triggered by expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The added paragraph applies upon expiration or termination of the Agreement or any Service Option Attachment.
IBM is expressly required to provide transition assistance at Customer's request.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to 6 months.
elements.evidence: Subsection (a) provides assistance for up to six months.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be charged at Vendor's then-current rates.
elements.evidence: Subsection (a) expressly applies IBM's then-current rates.
The operative provision covers “Content,” not Customer Data, and no definition establishing that Content includes all Customer Data is supplied. The margin comment is non-operative.

elements.element: The Customer Data return must occur within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Although subsection (b) contains a 30-day deadline, it applies to “Content”; it is not demonstrably a deadline for return of all Customer Data.

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: The specified format applies to “Content,” which is not shown to include all Customer Data.

elements.element: After returning Customer Data, Vendor must delete it.
elements.evidence: Subsection (c) requires deletion of “Content” after return, but does not demonstrably require deletion of all Customer Data.

elements.element: After deletion, Vendor must certify the deletion.
elements.evidence: IBM must certify deletion in writing, but the certification concerns deletion of “Content,” not demonstrably all Customer Data.

elements.element: The transition-assistance obligation must be triggered by expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The added paragraph applies upon expiration or termination of the Agreement or any Service Option Attachment.
IBM is expressly required to provide transition assistance at Customer's request.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for 90 days.
elements.evidence: Assistance is available at Customer's request for up to six months, which exceeds 90 days.
Returning data in a standard machine-readable format constitutes an export mechanism, but the covenant applies only to “Content,” which is not shown to encompass all Customer Data.

elements.element: The Customer Data export must occur within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The 30-day deadline applies to return of “Content,” not demonstrably to export of all Customer Data.

result.reason: The operative language satisfies the transition-assistance duration and pricing requirements but does not establish that “Content” is coextensive with Customer Data, so neither data-return package is complete. It is also overbroad operationally: termination of any single Service Option Attachment triggers return and deletion of all Content, potentially disrupting surviving Service Option Attachments and conflicting with the original clause's preservation of obligations under those attachments. The non-operative margin comment cannot cure either issue.
